chunks.subject: AP Precalculus
chunks.title: Q3 — Periodic/Sinusoidal Function (6 points, no calculator)
chunks.content: AP Precalculus FRQ 3 (Part B, graphing calculator not allowed), 6 points, scored by lettered subparts. Q3 topic: analyzing a periodic/sinusoidal function (amplitude, period, midline, transformations; evaluating exact values; describing behavior). Points reward: correct identification of sinusoidal features, correct exact evaluations/solutions with work shown, and correct descriptions of function behavior. Common failure: sign/phase-shift errors; approximations where exact values are required; incomplete work.
